answer: Standing that only ripens with time blocks fake identities. A new agent's reputation is locked and unlocks a sliver per epoch, and only while peers keep rating its work as useful. A Sybil farmer cannot buy that history: each clone must survive months of real grading, paying compute and stake the whole way. A thousand fresh accounts are a gale of noise with zero weight, clones that echo each other get flagged, and trust stays as hard to fake as carved jade.
